# Tile

<p class="gls-text-lead">Create layout boxes with different backgrounds that can be arranged seamlessly next to each other.</p>

## Usage

To apply this component, add the `.gls-tile` class to a `<div>` element. By default, a tile is blank. That is why it is important to add one of the following modifier classes for styling.

| Class                | Description                          |
|----------------------|--------------------------------------|
| `.gls-tile-default`   | Applies the default tile background. |
| `.gls-tile-muted`     | Applies a muted tile background.     |
| `.gls-tile-primary`   | Applies the primary tile background. |
| `.gls-tile-secondary` | Applies a secondary tile background. |

```html
<div class="gls-tile gls-tile-default"></div>
```

<div class="gls-child-width-1-2@s gls-grid-collapse gls-text-center" gls-grid>

            <p class="gls-h4">Default</p>
        </div>
    </div>
    <div>

            <p class="gls-h4">Muted</p>
        </div>
    </div>
    <div>
        <div class="gls-tile gls-tile-primary">
            <p class="gls-h4">Primary</p>
        </div>
    </div>
    <div>
        <div class="gls-tile gls-tile-secondary">
            <p class="gls-h4">Secondary</p>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
</div>

### Preserve color

The `.gls-tile-primary` and `.gls-tile-secondary` classes are extending the inverse style from the [Inverse component](https://getuikit.com/docs/inverse) automatically. If you want to prevent this behavior, for example because you are using [cards](https://getuikit.com/docs/card) in these sections, add the `.gls-preserve-color` class.

```html
<div class="gls-tile gls-tile-primary gls-preserve-color"></div>
```

## Tile and padding

The Tile component has some padding by default. To remove this or to apply different spacing, add one of the classes from the [Padding component](https://getuikit.com/docs/padding).

```html
<div class="gls-tile gls-tile-default gls-padding-large"></div>
```

<div class="gls-docs-example">
<div class="gls-child-width-1-3@s gls-grid-small gls-text-center" gls-grid>
    <div>
        <div class="gls-tile gls-tile-muted gls-padding-remove">
            <p class="gls-h4">Remove</p>
        </div>
    </div>
    <div>
        <div class="gls-tile gls-tile-primary gls-padding-small">
            <p class="gls-h4">Small</p>
        </div>
    </div>
    <div>
        <div class="gls-tile gls-tile-secondary gls-padding-large">
            <p class="gls-h4">Large</p>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
</div>

